Orang Jawa menyebut Dieng sebagai tempat:
Javanese people call Dieng the abode of the gods. Thousands of years ago an ancient volcano collapsed, leaving a cold, misty and silent highland. The oldest temples in Java stand there, built by people who believed the sky is closest from a place this high.

We invite you there not to chase photos. We want you to feel a slow morning: the biting air, clouds flowing beneath your feet, and a pause from the bustle you have long been missing.

Bagi masyarakat Tengger, Bromo bukan sek:
For the Tengger people, Bromo is more than a mountain. According to legend, the couple Roro Anteng and Joko Seger asked the gods for children, promising to offer their youngest child to the crater. To this day, the Tengger still climb every year carrying offerings as a sign of gratitude and a promise kept.

This journey takes you to stand on the land they have guarded for generations, watch the sun rise over the sea of sand, and go home with a story bigger than mere scenery.

Sebelum fajar, ketika kebanyakan orang m:
Before dawn, when most people are still asleep, Ijen's sulfur miners are already walking up. They carry sulfur on their shoulders, descend into a crater whose fumes sting the eyes, and then do it again and again. In the same darkness, a blue fire glows from the cracks of the earth, a rare sight seen in only a few places in the world.

Ijen is an honest place. It is beautiful and harsh at once, and after standing on the rim of its crater you will see work, hope, and nature in a different way.

Di selatan Bandung, letusan Gunung Patuh:
South of Bandung, an eruption of Mount Patuha once left a crater that is now whitish green and looks like a painting. Not far from there is Situ Patenggang, a lake that, according to the story, was born from the meeting of two lovers who had been apart for a long time and finally found each other.

Ciwidey suits those who want to travel without rushing: cool air, expanses of tea, and enough time to sit quietly with the person you brought along.

Sungai Cijulang mengukir tebing batu sel:
The Cijulang River has carved the rock cliffs for thousands of years, and the result is the green corridor now known as Green Canyon. Locals call it Cukang Taneuh, "the earth bridge", and have long guided anyone who wants to see it up close.

You will glide over calm water between rock walls covered in moss and roots, then pause as sunlight falls through the gaps. This place is a reminder that beauty often comes from patient processes.

Papandayan pernah mengamuk. Letusan pada:
Papandayan once raged. The 2002 eruption felled the forest on its slopes and left pale trunks standing like silent guardians. From that scar something new was born: the Tegal Alun edelweiss meadow, now blooming at altitude, everlasting flowers growing where the land was once scorched.

This journey is about rising again. You will walk past the mountain's scars and end up in a quiet place where nature shows how it starts over.
Tidak semua perjalanan terbaik sudah ter:
Not every great journey is written in a brochure. Some are born from one small wish: seeing the sunrise at a place you have long dreamed of, taking your parents to a highland they have never seen, or simply going away with loved ones without being chased by time.

Tell us what is on your mind. Our local team will help turn it into a journey that feels like your own.
